zh.title: 500 元的订单，收到了 790 元的回执。AI 员工该再订一笔吗？
zh.summary: 正式改价后，接班 AI 怎样判断该沿用原单、补订，还是继续查？两轮 CodeFlowMu 对照记录了 Agent 的实际行动和订单账本。

en.title: The booking was for ¥500. The receipt says ¥790. Should the AI book again?
en.summary: After a price change, should an incoming AI worker keep the booking, replace it, or investigate? Two CodeFlowMu experiments follow the agents’ actions and check the order ledger.
